critical.issue: Stripe rejects the phase spec: `Received unknown parameter: phases[iterations]`. Stripe REMOVED `iterations` from SubscriptionSchedule phases in API version basil, 2025-08-27. Backend at /app/backend/routes/payments.py:583-590 sends `phases=[{items:..., iterations:1}, {items:..., iterations:1}]` → HTTP 400 from Stripe → 502 to caller. Fix: replace `iterations: 1` with `duration: {"interval": "day", "interval_count": 14}` (Wayly bills fortnightly), or better read the phase duration from the current price (price.recurring.interval / interval_count), or compute an `end_date` from `_sub_period_end(sub)` for phase 0 and drop the iterations key for phase 1. Root cause docs: https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/basil/2025-08-27/remove_schedule_phase_iterations.md

rca of the issue: Stripe API version basil (2025-08-27) removed the `iterations` parameter from SubscriptionSchedule phases; the parameter is now rejected as unknown. Wayly's schedule-downgrade fix (routes/payments.py:583-590) uses `iterations: 1` on both phases, so every call fails with `parameter_unknown` and the handler surfaces a 502. Fix: use `duration: {interval: 'day', interval_count: 14}` for each phase (matches Wayly's 14-day billing cycle stated in the trial-end reminder email), OR read the interval from the current Stripe price via `price.recurring.interval` / `interval_count` so it stays in sync if pricing terms change.
